INDEPENDENT · UNOFFICIAL FIELD GUIDE

Azeroth Survivors Warlock build

Last updated: October 29, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Warlock is an S-tier snowball. DoTs that keep working after the target dies, demon pets, and self-healing mean the class gets stronger the longer a wave lasts. The community shell is Soul Link plus Drain Soul. It is not as immediately safe as Hunter, but once talents come online it scales harder than any other ranged class.

Build phases

0–3 min

Take Rain of Fire or another area card so the early wave produces experience.

3–8 min

Commit to the Soul Link / Drain Soul shell, with one survival tool. Let DoTs and demon pets maintain damage while you move.

8–15 min

Rank up the carry, then cooldown reduction. Do not add extra control at the expense of boss burst.

Boss notes

Keep DoTs and demon damage working while repositioning. Self-healing does not remove the need to dodge.

Common mistakes

Expecting the full snowball before talents are online. Standing still for damage. Dividing ranks among too many spells.

Skill priority

  • Rain of Fire or early area coverage.
  • Soul Link / Drain Soul shell.
  • One survival tool.
  • Carry ranks and cooldown reduction.

Passive priority

  1. Blessing of Might — +10% all damage per rank, +50% at rank 5. It helps every build; take it first.
  2. Arcane Intellect — 8% faster recharge per rank, 40% at rank 5, total capped at 65%.
  3. Amplify Magic — +10% area size per rank, +50% at rank 5. Huge for Flamestrike, Consecration, Volley.
  4. Blessing of Wisdom — +8% experience per rank, +40% at rank 5. Take it early or not at all.
  5. Power Word: Fortitude — +20% max health per rank, +100% at rank 5. Buffer on squishier classes.
  • See the full passive priority and stat caps

FAQ

Is Warlock a good first-clear choice?

Read the Warlock trade-off above and the tier list. Warrior or Paladin remains the forgiving first-clear starting point.

What should I take in the first three minutes?

Take Rain of Fire or another area card so the early wave produces experience.

When should I spend rerolls?

Use the level 6–12 commitment window, rather than spending rerolls in the first three levels.

What is the main Warlock mistake?

Expecting the full snowball before talents are online. Standing still for damage. Dividing ranks among too many spells.
